releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.9.7 — Master Anti-Spike Voltage Lock & Silent 0 RPM Cooling:
- VoltMaster v5.1 Dynamic Thermal Governor: Permanently locks Zen 4 base voltage to ~1.05V (PERFBOOSTMODE 0 + EPP 128) during desktop use, browsing, and media, dropping idle/light temperatures from 75°C down to 36°C–42°C.
- Heavy Compilation & Gaming Boost: Dynamically bursts to 4.8 GHz only during heavy code builds or active 3D games, then immediately locks back to cool 1.05V base within 1 second.
- AeroCore v5.1 Fan Control: Strict 0 RPM Silent Floor below 54°C on AC and 50°C on battery, eliminating all fan revving and acoustic stepping.
- Non-intrusive PowerNap v5 (zero NVIDIA driver alerts on lock).
